record.question:
A party is recognized as a state party in a state if:
(i) It secures 6% of the valid votes polled in the state at a general election to the legislative Assembly of the state concerned
(ii) It secures 4% of the valid votes polled in the state at a general election of the Lok Sabha from the state concerned
(iii) It wins 3% of seats in the legislative assembly at a general election to the legislative Assembly of the state concerned
(iv) It wins 1 seat in the Lok Sabha for every 25 seats or any fraction thereof allotted to the state at a general election to the Lok Sabha from the state concerned
